_comment: GENERATED from BioRand's own Re4rRandomizerConfigurationDefinition (fork biorand-re4r-ap). Do not hand-edit: re-dump when BioRand's options change. defaults[] = [mode1, mode2, mode3]. AP-locked keys (campaign/start-chapter/skip-ashley-section/game-version/ap-mode/ap-placements) are deliberately absent - ManifestBuilder forces them last so no preset can strand a check.

items.label: Professional Autosaves
items.description: Enable autosaves on professional difficulty

items.label: Disable Radio Calls
items.description: Disable radio calls so they do not interrupt gameplay.

items.label: Randomize Text
items.description: Randomize various text in the game to a meme.

items.label: Random Events
items.description: New environments, battle arenas and key movement. Requires Random Items AND Random Enemies - it is switched off automatically if either is disabled.

items.label: Allow Bonus Weapons
items.description: Let Biorand include the unlockable weapons (Primal Knife, Chicago Sweeper, Handcannon, Infinite Rocket Launcher) in the pool. You must have all the weapons unlocked.

items.label: Allow DLC Weapons
items.description: DLC weapons can appear in the item pool. This does NOT affect the multiworld placeholder item, which is placed by id.

items.label: Allow Mercenaries Weapons
items.description: Let Biorand include the Mercenaries weapons (Sawed-off W-870, XM96E1) in the pool. You must have Mercenaries installed and enabled.

items.label: Zero Bonus/DLC Weapon Sell Prices
items.description: Set the sell price of bonus/DLC weapons to 0 (except starting ones). Sell them at first merchant so they can appear in the rando later on.

items.label: Automatic Bolt Thrower
items.description: If enabled, the bolt thrower can be repeatedly fired without loading a new bolt each time.

items.label: Front-loaded case drops
items.description: Larger case upgrades are guaranteed to be available by certain chapters. If disabled, you may find larger case upgrades are not available until the second half of the game.

items.label: Charms
items.description: The number of different charms to include in the seed.

items.label: Weapons (per class)
items.description: The number of different weapons per class to include in the seed. 2 would include 2 shotguns, and 2 hanguns, etc.

items.label: Extra Hiding Lockers
items.description: Whether to add additional lockers that Ashley can hide in.

items.label: Traps
items.description: The amount of bear traps, and trip wires in the randomizer. Random events override any nearby traps.

items.label: Exploding Containers
items.description: The amount of breakable containers which explode.

items.label: Extra Merchants
items.description: Adds extra merchant locations. Cannot affect multiworld checks.

items.label: Purchase Hold Time
items.description: The number of seconds you need to hold the purchase button down for. Setting to 0 is convenient for buying individual bullets. Vanilla game uses 0.6.

items.label: Random Shop
items.description: Let Biorand randomize the merchant's shop.

items.label: Random Shop Prices
items.description: Let Biorand randomize the merchant's shop prices.

items.label: Random Upgraded Weapon Stats
items.description: Let Biorand randomize the upgraded weapon stats.

items.label: Random Weapon Upgrade Prices
items.description: Let Biorand randomize the merchant's prices for weapon upgrades.

items.label: Random Weapon Upgrades
items.description: Let Biorand randomize the weapon upgrade paths.

items.label: Random Weapon Exclusives
items.description: Let Biorand randomize the weapon exclusive upgrades.

items.label: Random Inventory
items.description: Let Biorand randomize your starting inventory.

items.label: Additional Recipes
items.description: Adds additional recipes for crafting ammo from other ammo. Warning: replaces herb recipes which may be unwanted when stack multiplier is enabled.

items.label: Random Case Perks
items.description: Randomize the perk and multiplier of each attaché case.

items.label: Min. Average Chapter Treasure (× 1,000)
items.description: The minimum total value of all treasure to include for an average length chapter.

items.label: Max. Average Chapter Treasure (× 1,000)
items.description: The maximum total value of all treasure to include for an average length chapter.

items.label: Low
items.description: Higher value will result in a greater ratio of smaller treasures versus containers and large treasures.Small treasures are typically treasures with sub 10,000 pstas value.

items.label: Container
items.description: Higher value will result in a greater ratio of treasures that contain slots for gems versus small and large treasures.Compatible gems will be also placed to fit inside the treasure.

items.label: High
items.description: Higher value will result in a greater ratio of large treasures versus containers and small treasures.Large treasures are typically treasures with greater than 10,000 pstas value.

items.label: Slotted Treasure Multiplier
items.description: The number of gems to place per slot in container type treasures. E.g. 2 will place twice as many compatible gems per container slot.

items.label: Enemies
items.description: Ratio of treasure found as enemy drops.

items.label: Items
items.description: Ratio of treasure found as static items.

items.label: Min. Treasure Merchant Rewards
items.description: The minimum number of treasures to include as a Merchant Spinel Reward.

items.label: Max. Treasure Merchant Rewards
items.description: The maximum number of treasures to include as a Merchant Spinel Reward.

items.label: Random Items
items.description: BioRand re-rolls every NON-CHECK item in the world. Your Archipelago checks are always shuffled by the multiworld and are never touched by this.

items.label: Ammo for available weapons only
items.description: Only drop ammo for weapons that are available before or in the chapter with the drop.

items.label: Min. Ammo Quantity
items.description: The minimum percentage of an ammo stack to drop.

items.label: Max. Ammo Quantity
items.description: The maximum percentage of an ammo stack to drop.

items.label: Preserve Item Models
items.description: When randomizing items, keep the original item model in the world.

items.label: Random Enemies
items.description: BioRand re-rolls enemy placements, types and bosses.

items.label: Extra Enemies
items.description: The percentage of extra enemy spawns to add. (Includes peaceful areas, and boss arenas.)

items.label: Enemy Multiplier
items.description: Duplicate enemies by this amount. Warning: high values can cause stability issues.

items.label: Enemy Variety
items.description: Controls how many different enemy types you can have in a single area.

items.label: Enemy Max. Pack Size
items.description: Controls the maximum size of an enemy pack. Enemy packs give you groups of similar enemies rather than every individual enemy being a different type.

items.label: Enemy Wave Probability
items.description: The percentage of enemy spawns that will have waves.

items.label: Enemy Wave Distance
items.description: The minimum distance the player needs to be for a spawn point to spawn a new enemy.

items.label: Min. Enemy Waves
items.description: The minimum number of waves per enemy. A value of 2 will mean a new enemy is spawned for each enemy killed.

items.label: Max. Enemy Waves
items.description: The maximum number of waves per enemy. A value of 4 will mean some enemies will get another 3 extra enemies which spawn in, one after another, when the last one is killed.

items.label: Unusual scale probability
items.description: The percentage of enemies that are an unusual size.

items.label: Min. Enemy Scale
items.description: The minimum scale multiplier of enemies.

items.label: Max. Enemy Scale
items.description: The maximum scale multiplier of enemies.

items.label: Balanced Enemies
items.description: Restrict certain enemies to a set of types that produce a more fair and consistent randomizer. Good for permadeath runs but may reduce chaos.

items.label: Safer Mendez Hill / Krauser Fight
items.description: Prevent difficult enemies appearing on Mendez Hill and first Krauser fight. Enable this during your permadeath runs.

items.label: Safer Ashley Escorting
items.description: Disable enemies that can easily kill Ashley during chapters where you are escorting her.

items.label: Strong Mini Bosses
items.description: Randomize mini bosses to strong elite enemies. Examples of mini bosses are bella sisters, red zealot with lantern, and garradors.

items.label: Mendez Down Resistance
items.description: Higher percentage will increase required number of hits on Mendez to down him.

items.label: Araña Latch Probability
items.description: The probability that an Araña (spider plaga thing) will latch onto another enemy and control it.

items.label: Enemies Unleashed
items.description: Reduce the colliders for Verdugo, Garrador, dogs, Novi, Mendez so they can move more freely.

items.label: None
items.description: No Plaga

items.label: Plaga Guadaña
items.description: Tenticle Plaga that slice you

items.label: Plaga Mandíbula
items.description: Hungry Plaga that eat your head

items.label: Plaga Araña
items.description: Spider Plaga that come off and attack you or control another enemy.

items.label: Random enemy drops
items.description: Let Biorand randomize the enemy drops.

items.label: Ammo for available weapons only
items.description: Only drop ammo for weapons that are available before or in the chapter with the drop.

items.label: Min. Ammo Quantity
items.description: The minimum percentage of an ammo stack to drop.

items.label: Max. Ammo Quantity
items.description: The maximum percentage of an ammo stack to drop.

items.label: None
items.description: No item is dropped.

items.label: Automatic
items.description: Let the game decide, usually based on DA.

items.label: Random Boss Health
items.description: Let Biorand randomize the boss health using the min/max values.

items.label: Random Enemy Health
items.description: Let Biorand randomize the enemy health using the min/max values.
